positions.title: Intern (Game Development)
positions.description:

• Collected 50k+ play trials from 12 different games of competing companies to observe trending game features
• Performed statistical analysis on the collected data to improve future products with insightful results
• Consulted with 20+ game developers and designers on product specifications (development, visuals, audio, etc.) of 4 different games
positions.insights: User Experience (UX), Data Analysis and +3 skills

positions.insights: Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), Military Training and +3 skills

projects.title: Brew
projects.description:
• Built a functioning prototype of a dating app using Figma, Dart and Flutter, from ideation to UI 
• Utilized an SQL database to store user data and dating information
• Utilized Firebase and multiple APIs to improve the performance of the app

projects.title: Natural Language Processing Research
projects.description:
• Developed a text mining program via Python and NLTK to process 20k+ lines of raw text into csv data on Pandas
• Performed topic modelling via scikit-learn’s LDA to analyze csv data
• Published on paper "Understanding the Effects of Information Cues on Product Choices"
